raw_html: [[Sneak Attack Bonus| Sneak Attack Bonus +2]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Sneak Attack Bonus| Sneak Attack Bonus +2]]''' : Provides a +2 Enhancement modifier to your attack bonus and a +3 Enhancement bonus to damage for any attack that would qualify as a Sneak Attack, even if the wielder is not a Rogue.
